text:
marie_cs: Heads-up: novaedge dedicated pool scheduled for production traffic next Tue 09:00 PT. Need final quota numbers, autoscale policy, and a short load test window. @josh_eng @anya_sre

josh_eng: Thanks — can we lock quotas by EOD Fri? What's expected peak qps and P95 tokens?

devon_cust: We'll push ~1200 qps peak for the first hour, sustained ~600 qps after. P95 latency target <200ms. SLA yes.

anya_sre: Okay. Re autoscale: recommend target_util 0.65, min_instances 2, burst_limit 3. Will simulate with our load harness Wed.

olga_prod: Adding: must enable graceful fallback to f32-quant model_variant for cold starts. Also need a canary route for 10% traffic for first 30m.

josh_eng: Auto policy draft (putting here so ops can copy):

```
{
  "target_util": 0.65,
  "min_instances": 2,
  "max_instances": 10,
  "scale_up_window_s": 60,
  "scale_down_window_s": 300,
  "burst_limit": 3
}
```

marie_cs: Canary config noted. @sam_sales any billing/commit impact for early spike?

sam_sales: We can absorb first 24h spike under credits; beyond that we'll true-up. I'll flag finance for quota commit if they exceed 1.2M tokens/day.

load-bot: scheduled load test: 2026-03-25T02:00Z -> 2026-03-25T03:00Z; script: `./load_runner --profile novaedge_peak --rps 1200` :mega: 

josh_eng: Quick smoke command we'll run before the window: `wrk -c 200 -t 8 -d 60s http://dedicated.novaedge/api/generate`

anya_sre: If smoke passes, I'll run a rolling restart on the pool to verify priming and KV cache behavior. Will also capture token-per-second metrics and cache hit ratio.

devon_cust: App team will be on call for the load window. We'll watch error rates and can reduce traffic if needed.

marie_cs: :thumbsup: Final asks: Josh update autoscale JSON in config repo, Anya post load test results in this thread, Sam confirm billing fallback plan. I'll run post-load debrief and capture any feedback for the enablement doc.

anya_sre: Will do. If anything fails, fallback plan is to route 30% to hosted failover region and engage oncall. Queuing the run now.
